title: cvars
summary: Benilla's cvars.rs is host plumbing: a registered CVar table bridging engine knobs to the Lua GetCVar/SetCVar API, config.toml diff-persistence, and env overrides. MSUI has no Lua VM to serve, and its settings knobs (sound volumes/enables, UI scale, farclip/view distance, name toggles, world detail, auto-loot, etc.) live in its own typed settings system with its own persistence - the player-observable effect (options that stick across sessions) is achieved through MSUI's architecture. Current cameraSmoothStyle, cameraSmoothTrackingStyle and cameraYawSmoothSpeed are now represented by typed, persisted ControlSettings and consumed by CameraFollowLaw; only the reference-visible style has an Options row, matching current Benilla.
